About

Long before I knew what a structural load was, I knew the sound of a job site. Construction runs in my family, and I grew up surrounded by words I did not understand and a stubborn need to learn what each one meant. That curiosity led me to civil engineering.

Civil engineering gave me the answers, from how structures carry their loads and how concrete is designed to how the ground beneath a building decides what can stand on it. At DesignTree Service Consultants, those ideas came off the page. I worked on the structural design of high-rise residential buildings and walked sites to check that what was built matched what was drawn. Over time, I realized that what held my attention most was the coordination, the way many people and decisions must line up for a project to come together.

That realization led me to construction management. In my M.S. in Construction Management and Technology at Arizona State University, I have learned to estimate, bid, level bids, and select trade partners, working in Procore, Bluebeam, Revit, and InEight. I also hold the LEED Green Associate credential and Procore Project Management certification.

Now, I am looking for a co-op or internship where I can apply all of this on real projects and keep learning from preconstruction through closeout.
